help_output:
Immich CLI — Agent-native control and careful personal-library rituals for a self-hosted Immich instance.

Highlights (not in the official API docs):
  • album event   Create or update a reviewable shared event album from explicit Immich search filters.
  • duplicates plan   Preview native duplicate groups and a deterministic keeper proposal without changing assets.
  • duplicates apply   Resolve selected native duplicate groups only after an explicit apply confirmation.
  • people july   Find one or two people across past Julys using real people and metadata search endpoints.
  • memories review   List recent native memories with their dates and asset counts for an intentional review.
  • library review   Review bounded favorite and archived asset search results without mutating the library.
  • stacks review   Inspect native stacks for empty, singleton, and unusually large groups without changing them.
  • library health   Report partner-sharing and worker-queue facts from the configured Immich server.

Add --agent to any command for JSON output + non-interactive mode.
Run 'immich-pp-cli doctor' to verify auth and connectivity.

Usage:
  immich-pp-cli [command]

Available Commands:
  activities      An activity is a like or a comment made by a user on an asset or album.
  admin           List, get, search, create, update, delete, upload, download, and send admin
  agent-context   Emit structured JSON describing this CLI for agents
  album           Reviewable personal album workflows
  albums          An album is a collection of assets that can be shared with other users or via shared links.
  analytics       Run analytics queries on locally synced data
  api-keys        An api key can be used to programmatically access the Immich API.
  assets          An asset is an image or video that has been uploaded to Immich.
  auth            Manage authentication for Immich
  completion      Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  doctor          Check CLI health
  download        Endpoints for downloading assets or collections of assets.
  duplicates      Endpoints for managing and identifying duplicate assets.
  export          Export data to JSONL or JSON for backup, migration, or analysis
  faces           A face is a detected human face within an asset, which can be associated with a person.
  feedback        Record feedback about this CLI (local by default; upstream opt-in)
  help            Help about any command
  immich-auth     Get, create, update, and delete immich auth
  immich-jobs     Get, run, and create immich jobs
  immich-search   Get and create immich search
  immich-sync     Get, delete, and send immich sync
  import          Import data from JSONL file via API create/upsert calls
  learnings       Inspect or forget the local search_learnings table
  libraries       An external library is made up of input file paths or expressions that are scanned for asset files.
  library         Personal-library review and health rituals
  map             Map endpoints include supplemental functionality related to geolocation
  memories        A memory is a specialized collection of assets with dedicated viewing implementations in the web and mobile clients.
  notifications   A notification is a specialized message sent to users to inform them of important events.
  oauth           Get and create oauth
  partners        A partner is a link with another user that allows sharing of assets between two users.
  people          A person is a collection of faces, which can be favorited and named. A person can also be merged into another person.
  playbook        Inspect or amend stored CLI playbooks
  plugins         A plugin is an installed module that makes filters and actions available for the workflow feature.
  profile         Named sets of flags saved for reuse
  queues          Queues and background jobs are used for processing tasks asynchronously. Queues can be paused and resumed as needed.
  recall          Check prior learnings for a query before running discovery (LLM-fired, pre-discovery)
  search          Full-text search across synced data or live API
  server          Information about the current server deployment, including version and build information, available features
  sessions        A session represents an authenticated login session for a user.
  shared-links    A shared link is a public url that provides access to a specific album, asset, or collection of assets.
  stacks          A stack is a group of related assets. One asset is the 'primary' asset, and the rest are 'child' assets.
  sync            Sync API data to local SQLite for offline search and analysis
  system-config   Endpoints to view, modify, and validate the system configuration settings.
  system-metadata Endpoints to view, modify, and validate the system metadata
  tags            A tag is a user-defined label that can be applied to assets for organizational purposes.
  tail            Stream live changes by polling the API at regular intervals
  teach           Record a query -> resource mapping for future recall (LLM-fired, silent)
  teach-lookup    Install a manual entity-lookup row (kind, canonical, value)
  teach-pattern   Install a manual generalization pattern (query_template, resource_template, entity_kind)
  teach-playbook  Record a CLI playbook + free-text notes for a query family
  timeline        Specialized endpoints related to the timeline implementation used in the web application.
  trash           Endpoints for managing the trash can, which includes assets that have been discarded.
  users           Endpoints for viewing and updating the current users, including product key information, profile picture data
  version         Print version
  view            Endpoints for specialized views, such as the folder view.
  which           Find the command that implements a capability
  workflow        Compound workflows that combine multiple API operations
  workflows       A workflow is a set of actions that run whenever a triggering event occurs.

Flags:
      --agent                   Set all agent-friendly defaults (--json --compact --no-input --no-color --yes)
      --allow-partial-failure   Downgrade response-body partial-failure (e.g. partialFailureError) to a warning instead of a non-zero exit
      --compact                 Return only key fields (id, name, status, timestamps) for minimal token usage
      --config string           Config file path
      --csv                     Output as CSV (table and array responses)
      --data-source string      Data source for read commands: auto (live with local fallback), live (API only), local (synced data only) (default "auto")
      --deliver string          Route output to a sink: stdout (default), file:<path>, webhook:<url>
      --dry-run                 Show request without sending
  -h, --help                    help for immich-pp-cli
      --home string             Root directory for config, data, state, and cache files
      --human-friendly          Enable colored output and rich formatting
      --idempotent              Treat already-existing create results as a successful no-op
      --ignore-missing          Treat missing delete targets as a successful no-op
      --json                    Output as JSON
      --max-age duration        Maximum acceptable age of local-store data before a stderr hint suggests sync; 0 disables (default 30m0s)
      --no-cache                Bypass response cache
      --no-color                Disable colored output
      --no-input                Disable all interactive prompts (for CI/agents)
      --no-learn                Disable the teach/recall learning loop for this invocation
      --plain                   Output as plain tab-separated text
      --profile string          Apply values from a saved profile (see 'immich-pp-cli profile list')
      --quiet                   Bare output, one value per line
      --rate-limit float        Max requests per second (0 to disable)
      --select string           Comma-separated fields to include in output (e.g. --select id,name,status)
      --timeout duration        Request timeout (default 1m0s)
  -v, --version                 version for immich-pp-cli
      --yes                     Skip confirmation prompts (for agents and scripts)

Use "immich-pp-cli [command] --help" for more information about a command.
